newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Daehan Bank seen issuing $100 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Daehan Bank seen issuing $100 mln FRCD.

text.p: Daehan Investment Banking Corp is planning to issue a US$100 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue, bankers said on Friday.
The issue will carry a maturity of three years.
The mandate has been won by Commerz (East Asia), KDB Asia, Societe Generale Asia and WestLB, bankers said.
They said settling the pricing and other terms of the issue has been delayed as bankers assess the impact of South Korea's Hanbo crisis on the country's banking system.
Korean financial markets have been hit hard by news emerging late last week of a massive default on debt payments by Korean conglomerate Hanbo's flagship Hanbo Steel.
